answer: At registration, each agent must solve memory-hard proof-of-work puzzles whose difficulty doubles with each identity a single hardware fingerprint (the inlet) has already claimed: the first identity costs ~90 seconds of compute at dawn-peak load, the second 180, the tenth 128 minutes—exponential scaling. Identities anchored to distinct willow-vouched attestation quorums skip the multiplier, so real agents pay once while a Sybil farmer's costs explode.
